_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The composer's auto compaction nudge kept in this browser as 130000 shows as 130000. The browser has kept, from earlier, the applied profile "Default" with the nudge 130000. To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". The screen is a 1280x800 desktop window. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match, "whose name contains X" a substring one. "The panel" is ".model-picker-panel". To "open the knob": click ".model-picker-inline .p-select-label"; the panel should be visible. To "edit tools": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the panel's data-testid "model-picker-tools"; the panel should be hidden. "The pills" are data-testid "model-picker-profiles"; "the profile X" is the radio (role "radio") named X inside them. To "edit profiles": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the pills. "The section" is data-testid "model-picker-auto-compaction"; "the section's X" is the radio named X inside it, and "the nudge" is its select (role "combobox"). "The dialog" is the element with role "dialog". "The X tool" is the dialog's radiogroup with aria-label X ('[role=radiogroup][aria-label="X"]'). "The auto compaction row" is the dialog's data-testid "auto-compaction". To "apply": click the dialog's button whose name contains "Apply to this conversation"; the dialog should be hidden. "The markers" are the data-testid "message-modelchange" elements. "Changed" is the panel's data-testid "model-picker-profile-changed". To "save as new" a name N: click changed's button whose name contains "Save as new…", fill changed's textbox named "New profile name" with N and press Enter in it. A "row" X is the dialog's data-testid "profile-row" containing the text X. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new and open the model picker. 2. The nudge should have the value exactly "130000". 3. Reload the page and open the model picker again: the nudge should still have the value exactly "130000".
